title: eludite.browser.screenshot input
description: Take a screenshot of a tab: the viewport (default), the whole page (`full_page`), or a clip (an element's ref or a rectangle). The image is scaled down to at most `max_width` pixels wide (default 1280) and comes back as an image. Costs about 50 to 150 ms and a few hundred kilobytes of context; prefer eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.find to locate elements, and use screenshots to check layout and visuals. Coordinates in the page are CSS pixels; `scale` converts them to image pixels. Fails with "no tab" when the browser has no tab: call eludite.browser.tab_open first.

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the viewport.

clip.description: Capture only this: an element's ref (its border box), or a rectangle in CSS pixels relative to the viewport.

anyOf.description: A ref (`e1`, `e2`, ...) from eludite.browser.read_page or eludite.browser.find in the current page generation.

max_width.description: The widest the image may be, in pixels (default 1280). A wider capture is scaled down.

quality.description: JPEG quality, 0 to 100 (default 80). Only with `format: jpeg`.

tab.description: The tab: its id from eludite.browser.tabs (`t1`, `t2`, ...). Default: the active tab (the one last opened or selected).
